rg.name: rg
rg.description: Search file contents quickly and precisely with ripgrep.

pattern.description: Regex to search for in file contents.

paths.description: One directory or an array of directories; defaults to cwd. Omit for the default—never pass null/undefined or join paths into one string.

output_mode.description: Output: matching lines (content, with context/line-number options), matching file paths (files_with_matches, default), or per-file counts (count).

type.description: File type filter, e.g. js, py, rust, go, or java; tsx/jsx normalize to ts/js.

-A.description: Context lines after matches; requires content mode.

-B.description: Context lines before matches; requires content mode.

-C.description: Context lines around matches; requires content mode.

-n.description: "-n": true adds line numbers; requires content mode.
